title: yummy crunchy argentinian pecan nuts empanadas
description: a satvik-friendly breakfast dish featuring crunchy argentinian pecan nuts
instructions: mix together the flour, salt, black pepper, and baking powder in a bowl.
add the cold-pressed olive oil to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
fry the pecan nuts in a pan with a little water until they are crunchy.
in a separate bowl, mix together the dates, apple cider vinegar, and almond milk until smooth.
add the nutritional yeast to the date mixture and mix until combined.
cut the dough into 6-8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a spoonful of the date mixture in the center of each disk.
place a few pecan nuts on top of the filling and fold the dough over to form a triangle or a square shape, pressing the edges together to seal the empanada.
place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
